howToPlay: Use the Seed Bomb to bounce shots around walls and hit enemies from a safe distance. Create tactical Hedge barriers with your Super to block paths or trap opponents. Manage your health with the Garden Mulcher gadget while using Overgrowth to increase your pressure on the map.
gears: Equip Damage to maximize your offensive potential when health is low and Super Charge to get your wall ability back faster. Shield provides extra protection to improve survivability against long-range attacks.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical area control and strategic positioning.
